If the primary host subsystem (or either of its components) fails, the backup can take over as the primary.\" The same bullet adds what the form drops: configured for nonstop active routing, the backup keeps its state in step with the primary and forwarding continues through a switchover"},"description":"CB-RE slots 0 and 1 at the ends of the fabric cage","index-origin":0,"role":"service","term":"Slot"},"sfbs":{"attrs":{"redundancy":"n+1","redundancy-note":"n+1 - mx2020 hardware guide, \"MX2000-SFB-S Switch Fabric Board Description\": \"Throughput of 6Tbps, with a minimum of 7 SFBs installed. Only seven SFB2s are required for line rate operation\" - and the fabric is all-active, so the spare is a working plane rather than a standby.
